description: This file defines the PlainTextErrorRenderer class responsible for rendering error messages in plain text format for the Slim Framework. It formats exceptions and their previous exceptions into human-readable strings, including details such as type, code, message, file, line, and trace.

classes.name: PlainTextErrorRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders error information as plain text for the Slim Framework, extending AbstractErrorRenderer.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the rendering of an exception as a plain-text error message, optionally including detailed exception traces based on the displayErrorDetails flag.

methods.name: formatExceptionFragment
methods.description: Formats a single Throwable exception into a detailed string including its type, code, message, file, line, and trace.
